description: pixel art interior of a small jeweller's workshop: a wooden workbench with a little grinding wheel, a magnifying lens on a stand, fine tools and trays of cut gemstones glinting, a candle, faint ice-blue glow from crystal shards on a shelf, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted dark palette of browns with gem-coloured and ice-blue accents, no text, no border, no people, no animals
